assignments.why: the market coming up a night early is recorded in this character's own book, in a hand that is not theirs; they are inside the scenario, not adjacent to it
the debt entry is in this character's hand and they did not write it; the scenario is them being asked for a second reading
the kid who wants a second pair of eyes on the ledger keeps the other book in the same market
she keeps everything on those shelves and has nothing of her own there, which is why refusing this loan falls to her and why she says she is the wrong person for it
the scenario is named for Corvin and is his eleven brokerings against one door; he is the situation
the rule he needs bent has never been bent for anybody, and she is the one at the desk who would have to bend it
thirty years of her never asking, and this scenario is the asking; he goes up, brings it down, and does not want to be standing there
the scenario is named for this character and is a week of their instruments ending at a kite-maker's door after dark
the workshop the Windreader walks to after dark belongs to somebody, and the two scenarios share the same Dreams
ten years of stamps they had no right to press, and the real inspector arriving mid-stamp; the scenario has no other centre
the guest is standing there believing a machine that loves them and this character has four hours; the clock is theirs
a specimen waking mid-stitch and arguing an election forty years out is this character's bench and their problem
dusk and dawn both, a clean chorus, and somebody who knows the bats will name which one is standing in the room
the scenario is three years of Pell at once and his own ledger is what flagged it; he has to be in the room saying nothing
they copied out the second verse and did not hum it; the hymnal has stopped pretending and they are the one holding it

assignments.scenarioTitle: The Night the Moon Leaned In
assignments.why: last drone, last light, and four seasons of the same arithmetic; tonight is the night somebody watches them choose
the queue is out the door and they have until she comes down to decide what they are; the scenario is their deadline

assignments.scenarioTitle: The Ring That Wasn't Grown Yet
assignments.why: best find of their career and worst news aboard, and the choice to rub it before the official log gets it is theirs to make
enough grafts taken to know an echo from a stubborn fact, and this scar keeps regrowing along the same seam; they are the one following it down
their mother's last note sung by the friend they were told they invented; the whole scenario is which of those two things is true
they touched the ballot too and remember a third thing, which is the reason checking their own recollection twice is the scenario
nineteen months of zero and a silent relief kitchen; they know exactly what the quiet costs, which is why the report is theirs
grounded by a council that does not exist yet, with entry sixty-two in a logbook they did not write; the scenario is their logbook
